title: Pepsi's Ad Showed a Fighter Jet. He Sent $700,000.
description:
A Pepsi ad showed a fighter jet as a prize... so a student sent Pepsi a check for $700,000.

In 1996, Pepsi Points could get you T-shirts and leather jackets. The ad ended with a teenager landing a Harrier jet at school, for 7,000,000 Pepsi Points. A 21-year-old business student near Seattle saw that extra points cost 10 cents each, so the jet would cost about $700,000. A real Harrier was worth more than $20 million. He got investors to lend him the money and mailed Pepsi 15 points and a check for the rest.

Pepsi sent the check back and said the jet was only there to be funny. In 1999 a judge ruled no reasonable person could think the ad was a serious offer. And Pepsi's new ad? The jet cost 700,000,000 points.

⚠️ Dramatised: characters and scenes are illustrations. The facts are real. This is history, not investment advice.
